description: This is a unit test class for the OAuthToken functionality within the SuiteCRM project, testing methods such as constructor, state setting, callback URL, token generation, save/load/invalidate, authorization, deletion, and other related operations.

classes.name: OAuthTokenTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for verifying OAuthToken behaviors in SuiteCRM, including creation, state management, callback URL, authorization, deletion, and data copying.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up test environment, initializes current user and default config.

methods.name: test__construct
methods.description: Tests the constructor of OAuthToken, verifying properties like module, object name, table name, and security flag.

methods.name: testsetState
methods.description: Tests setting the state of OAuthToken.

methods.name: testsetConsumer
methods.description: Tests assigning a consumer (OAuthKey) to the OAuthToken.

methods.name: testsetCallbackURL
methods.description: Tests setting the callback URL on OAuthToken.

methods.name: testgenerate
methods.description: Verifies that OAuthToken::generate creates a valid token object with non-empty token and secret.

methods.name: testSaveAndOthers
methods.description: Tests saving, loading, invalidating, authorizing, and deleting OAuthTokens.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads an OAuthToken by ID and verifies its existence.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.description: Invalidates an OAuthToken and checks its state.

methods.name: authorize
methods.description: Tests the authorization method of the token and verifies authorization data.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Deletes an OAuthToken record by ID and verifies it no longer exists.

methods.name: testcreateAuthorized
methods.description: Tests creation of an authorized OAuthToken with consumer and user details.

methods.name: copyAuthData
methods.description: Copies authorization data from one token to a new token.

methods.name: testqueryString
methods.description: Tests the queryString method with and without set token and secret.

methods.name: testcleanup
methods.description: Ensures the static cleanup method runs without exceptions.

methods.name: testdeleteByConsumer
methods.description: Tests deletion of tokens by consumer ID.

methods.name: testdeleteByUser
methods.description: Tests deletion of tokens by user ID.

methods.name: testdisplayDateFromTs
methods.description: Tests the date display function with empty and valid timestamp data.
